name: Filter
description: Filter the rows of a DataFrame using declarative conditions, named filter functions, and/or column equality selection, combined with a logical AND/OR.
usage: Provide any combination of: ``conditions``/``filter`` (a list of ``{column, expression, value}`` specs built by create_filter), ``fields`` (a column-to-value equality selection), and ``filter_conditions`` (a mapping of named filter function to its keyword arguments). ``operator`` chooses how the ``filter`` conditions are combined — ``&`` (AND, default) or ``|`` (OR). All inputs are optional and may be used together.

attributes.name: fields
attributes.description: Column-to-value equality selection: keep only rows where each column equals the given value (a list value matches any of its entries).

attributes.name: operator
attributes.description: Logical operator joining the ``filter`` conditions — ``&`` (AND, default) or ``|`` (OR).

attributes.name: conditions
attributes.description: List of filter conditions in create_filter format (``{column, expression, value}``). Optional; combinable with ``filter`` and ``filter_conditions``.

attributes.name: filter
attributes.description: List of filter specs (same ``{column, expression, value}`` format as ``conditions``) passed to create_filter; the resulting masks are joined with ``operator``.

attributes.name: filter_conditions
attributes.description: Mapping of named filter function (from querysource.types.dt.filters) to its keyword arguments, applied in order before the other filters.

json_schema.title: Filter

additionalProperties.description: Value (or list of values, OR-combined) the column must equal.

operator.description: Logical operator joining the ``filter`` conditions — ``&`` (AND, default) or ``|`` (OR).

filter_conditions.description: Named filter functions and their keyword arguments.

additionalProperties.description: Keyword arguments forwarded to the filter function.

json_schema.description: Reduce a DataFrame to the rows satisfying the given conditions / functions / field selections (SQL WHERE-like).

filterExpression.description: Comparison or text/null operator applied to a column. ``expression`` may also be a list to chain operators (create_filter_chain).

column.description: Column to test (must exist in the DataFrame).

expression.description: Comparison operator, or a list of operators to chain. Defaults to ``==``.

value.description: Value to compare against — a scalar, ``{"$column": "other_col"}`` for column-to-column comparison, or a function name when ``expression`` is ``func``/``function``. Omitted for ``is_null``/``not_null``/``is_empty``.
